news_items.headline: MAR closed up 3.28% on May 27; investors assess breakout momentum
news_items.summary: Marriott International shares rose 3.28% on May 27, 2026, attracting attention from investors tracking the move. No single fundamental catalyst cited; move attributed to broader market conditions and renewed buying interest.

news_items.headline: Susquehanna raises MAR price target to $385 citing strong luxury performance
news_items.summary: Susquehanna lifted its price target on MAR to $385 after noting strength in the luxury segment. The firm did not change its rating.

news_items.headline: Argus raises MAR PT to $425 from $420, keeps Buy after Q1 earnings beat
news_items.summary: Argus analyst John Staszak raised the firm's price target to $425 from $420 and maintained a Buy rating following Marriott's Q1 2026 earnings beat.

news_items.headline: Wells Fargo raises MAR PT to $446 from $443, keeps Overweight
news_items.summary: Wells Fargo made a modest upward revision to its price target on MAR, maintaining an Overweight rating.

news_items.headline: Truist Securities maintains Hold on MAR, raises PT to $356 from $350
news_items.summary: Truist Securities kept a Hold rating but nudged its price target higher by $6, indicating limited near-term upside conviction despite acknowledging improving fundamentals.

news_items.headline: MAR declares $0.73 cash dividend, ex-date May 22, 2026
news_items.summary: Marriott International declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.73 per share with an ex-dividend date of May 22, 2026. Routine capital return; no change to dividend policy signaled.

news_items.headline: Marriott expanding with mixed-use project in Kennewick and new online hotel furnishings shop
news_items.summary: Marriott announced a new mixed-use development project and launched an online shop selling hotel furnishings, part of broader portfolio and ancillary revenue expansion efforts.

news_items.headline: Elevated valuations prompt cautious near-term growth outlook for MAR
news_items.summary: Some analysts note that MAR's current valuation is elevated relative to historical multiples, tempering near-term growth expectations even as fundamentals remain solid.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Multiple PT raises this week: Argus to $425 (Buy), Wells Fargo to $446 (Overweight), Susquehanna to $385, Truist to $356 (Hold). Consensus of 26 analysts is Buy with average PT ~$377; overweight-oriented firms skew the high-conviction target toward $425-$446.

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 earnings already reported and beat EPS expectations ($2.60 EPS, +12.1% YoY). Key 2026 earnings catalyst is a 35% step-up in co-branded credit card royalty fees (Chase + Amex renegotiation), a one-time boost that normalizes to high-single-digit growth thereafter. Full-year guidance: RevPAR +1.5% to +2.5%, net rooms +4.5% to +5.0%. Next earnings date not confirmed in search results; Q2 2026 report likely in late July or early August.
